panel.title: Iftar for the fasting
panel.intro: Idris lays mats across the courtyard. Dates, water and lentil soup for anyone breaking their fast: travellers, the poor, the boys from the quay.
panel.secret_label: Ask Idris to keep it quiet
panel.secret_on: Idris will say only that the food is from “someone”.
panel.secret_locked: (You can give in secret once you have read the scholar's first page.)
panel.done_public: As the dates go round, Idris says: “Tonight's iftar is from the foreigner at the inn.”
panel.done_secret: As the dates go round, Idris says only: “Tonight's iftar is from someone who fasts with you.”

options.name: Dates and water for twenty
options.line: Enough for everyone on the courtyard mats.

options.name: Soup and bread for fifty
options.line: A full meal for the whole masjid tonight.
